surfaces.part: dark grass to light grass terrain tile (flat ground texture, left dark, right lighter)

There is no front-edge line, no eave shadow, no ellipse and no vertical front face. It reads as a flat top-down terrain tile, which is expected for a terrain autotile edge.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small dark-grass edge patch, only about one tile in the board, so I judged it mostly on the measured facts. The dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the darker greens are tinted by the material rather than a black sticker line. It is simpler than the full 4x3 reference grass patch, but it is not thinner or flatter than the reference tile of the same kind.
